remarks: Welcome to this move-in ready 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo in the heart of downtown Stamford! This first-floor unit offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort, making it an excellent alternative to renting. The open layout is bright and inviting, featuring a well-appointed kitchen, a spacious living area, and the ease of in-unit washer/dryer.  Enjoy the perks of building amenities, including a recently updated community patio with BBQs, tables, and plenty of seating-perfect for outdoor gatherings and entertaining, an on-site fitness center, a dedicated parking spot, the convenience of a live-in superintendent, and a welcoming, well-lit, and pristine lobby to walk into.  Step outside and find yourself within walking distance of Stamford's best restaurants, shopping, and public transportation, making both commuting and entertainment effortless. Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizing, or looking for a great investment property, this condo offers incredible value in a prime location.  Don't miss out-schedule a showing today!
